# Lanka Monitor

> Real-time situational awareness dashboard for Sri Lanka — money, weather, power, health, news, cricket.

## About

Lanka Monitor is a daily-life utility for Sri Lankans: one surface where the rupee, fuel price,
power cuts, weather warnings and news pulse explain each other. Trust is the product — every card
shows its own freshness timestamp. Stale data is surfaced, never silently served.

This is not investigative journalism. It is the morning check on a phone.

## Public API

Read-only JSON. No authentication. Cache responses; do not hammer upstream institutions.
All endpoints return `generated_at` (ISO timestamp). Stale/down sources are labeled explicitly.

### System
- GET /api/v1/health — freshness of every source (`fresh` | `stale` | `down` | `inactive`)

### Finance
- GET /api/v1/fx — latest USD/LKR buy/sell + ~30-day series (Central Bank of Sri Lanka)
- GET /api/v1/cse — ASPI and S&P SL20 index latest close + 30-day series (Colombo Stock Exchange)
- GET /api/v1/fuel — CEYPETCO pump prices: petrol_92, petrol_95, diesel, kerosene (LKR/litre)

### Environment
- GET /api/v1/weather — Colombo weather: temp_c, rain_mm, wind_kmh, humidity, weather_code (Open-Meteo)
- GET /api/v1/aqi — Colombo PM2.5 and AQI when OpenAQ ingest active

### Infrastructure
- GET /api/v1/power — CEB scheduled outage count + 14-day daily history

### Health
- GET /api/v1/dengue — national dengue cases (week) + WoW delta + top districts (Epidemiology Unit)

### News & Brief
- GET /api/v1/news — latest articles with optional cluster grouping
- GET /api/v1/brief — daily situation brief in EN/Sinhala/Tamil with citations

### Sport
- GET /api/v1/cricket — Sri Lanka cricket scores; feed_status `inactive` when CRICKET_API_KEY unset

### Notifications
- POST /api/telegram — send message to Telegram channel; 503 if TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN+CHAT_ID unset

### Open Graph
- GET /api/og — 1200×630 OG image with latest USD/LKR rate

Every response should be treated as timestamped. Attribute upstream sources and Lanka Monitor when republishing.

## Data principles

- Server-side cache only — page loads never hit government websites directly
- Honest User-Agent: LankaMonitorBot with contact URL
- Independent source failures — one dead scraper never blanks the page
- Honest empty states — cards display "refuses to guess" rather than stale guesses
- MIT licence — https://github.com/Cookie-Cat21/lanka-monitor

## Rate limits

60 requests/minute per IP for /api/v1/*. Best-effort (per-instance Map on serverless).
For sustained access, cache locally and poll at the stated revalidation interval.

## Optional pages

- /docs — human API notes with curl examples
- /health — source status UI
- /coconut — Coconut Index share card (HARTI food prices, when live)
